$$
\int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "c1f31b66-4d83-5de5-8508-4b8621695b0d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=- \sin{\left(x \right)}.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3 \sin{\left(x \right)}}{\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int 1/u\,\mathrm{d}u=\ln\left|u\right|+C.
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
-3\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=-3\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
-3\left(\ln\left|\cos{\left(x \right)} + 2\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "c1f31b66-4d83-5de5-8508-4b8621695b0d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "c1f31b66-4d83-5de5-8508-4b8621695b0d" :question/answer-fields "7c4f149b-9af0-50c6-90ce-998f03c6f69c"] [:db/ensure "c1f31b66-4d83-5de5-8508-4b8621695b0d" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "c1f31b66-4d83-5de5-8508-4b8621695b0d"] [:db/add "416eebd9-766a-53c2-84a2-7624a35963d6" :answer/id #uuid "416eebd9-766a-53c2-84a2-7624a35963d6"] [:db/add "416eebd9-766a-53c2-84a2-7624a35963d6" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "416eebd9-766a-53c2-84a2-7624a35963d6" :answer/value "- \frac{2}{3}\left(\ln\left|\cos^{3}{\left(x \right)} + 3\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "416eebd9-766a-53c2-84a2-7624a35963d6" :answer/validate] [:db/add "ddac9cd7-1f22-5149-bdab-a89527bc1324" :answer-field/id #uuid "ddac9cd7-1f22-5149-bdab-a89527bc1324"] [:db/add "ddac9cd7-1f22-5149-bdab-a89527bc1324" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "ddac9cd7-1f22-5149-bdab-a89527bc1324" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "ddac9cd7-1f22-5149-bdab-a89527bc1324" :answer-field/choices "416eebd9-766a-53c2-84a2-7624a35963d6"] [:db/add "ddac9cd7-1f22-5149-bdab-a89527bc1324" :answer-field/correct "416eebd9-766a-53c2-84a2-7624a35963d6"] [:db/ensure "ddac9cd7-1f22-5149-bdab-a89527bc1324" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "6ae6d24a-a614-50df-81d0-3360d1c1ce3a" :question/id #uuid "6ae6d24a-a614-50df-81d0-3360d1c1ce3a"] [:db/add "6ae6d24a-a614-50df-81d0-3360d1c1ce3a" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$

$$
\frac{1}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{2}\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
